text: Electronic information engineering is an interdisciplinary field that integrates electronic technology, information technology, communication technology and automatic control, focusing on the design, development and application of electronic devices and information systems. The core lies in achieving the acquisition, transmission, processing and control of information through technologies such as circuit design, signal processing and embedded systems. From smartphone chips to radar systems, from smart homes to industrial automation, this major covers the entire industrial chain of modern electronic information technology and is a key support for promoting the development of an intelligent and information-based society.
